title: Use various XXX-per-YYY definitions from wsutil/nstime.h.
description:
Replace other definitions - and some raw numbers - with them or with
values constructed from them.

notes.body: Minor, but we can probably get rid of the definition of `G_NSEC_PER_SEC` in `wsutil/glib-compat.h` if we're eliminating the uses of those GLib ones. The nanosecond symbol was only added in GLib 2.88.0, so we had to define it for systems compiling with earlier GLib and not define it as something different for platforms with newer GLib.
Or we could leave it. It depends on how strict we want to be about preferring the `WS_` defines to the GLib `G_` defines.

My inclination is to leave it for now. GLIb only offers `G_USEC_PER_SEC` and `G_NSEC_PER_SEC`, so if anything needs any other values, they'd need to use wsutil/nstime.h.

Speaking of which, should there be a separate wsutil/time_precision.h or something such as that, for stuff that's used by but not tied to `nstime_t`?
